title: Ice-region ship-ice collision energy-conservation surface (plastic hinge + double shell + Minorsky cross-check)
decision: Does a rigid-plastic hinge + membrane resistance model, solved by energy conservation, reproduce (a) its own closed-form anchor within 1 %, (b) the collision kinetic energy within 2 %, (c) the Minorsky (1959) empirical damaged volume within 30 % in his calibration regime - or must the collision energy surface be declared WITHHELD for ice-region damage-stability input?
alternatives_considered: Full nonlinear FE shell crush simulation (rejected: no verifiable closed-form anchor, far outside a single campaign node, and would not give a machine-checkable analytic criterion)
Pure Minorsky/empirical formula only (rejected: no physics, cannot output penetration depth or per-layer allocation, and gives no negative control)
Rigid-plastic hinge with membrane stretching + serial layer allocation + energy-conservation root solve (adopted)

hypotheses.H1: The plastic hinge energy E = M_p*theta_max reproduces an independent fibre-section/virtual-work route within 1 %.
hypotheses.H2: Energy conservation E_k = E_plastic(d) + E_friction(d) can be closed for the penetration depth with residual <= 2 % and is monotone in impact velocity.
hypotheses.H3: The model damaged steel volume agrees with the yield-scaled Minorsky (1959) relation within 30 % for collisions inside Minorsky's calibration regime.

outcome_metrics.anchor_max_relative_error: max over routes/mechanisms of |E_numeric - E_closed| / E_closed and |Z_fiber - b*t^2/4|/(b*t^2/4)
outcome_metrics.allocation_relative_error: |Simpson integral of dE/dd - sum_k E_k| / sum_k E_k
outcome_metrics.monotonicity: d(V) strictly increasing over V = 2/4/6/8 m/s

predeclared_thresholds.negative_control: V = 0 must give exactly d = 0 and V = 2 m/s must give d > 0, otherwise FAIL

comparison_domain_rule.rule: The Minorsky cross-check is judged only for cases with collision energy in 10-400 MJ (Minorsky's 1959 data range) AND a fully developed plastic mechanism, d/frame_span >= 0.75.
comparison_domain_rule.rationale: Minorsky's 47.1 MJ/m^3 embeds fracture/tearing of fully damaged structure; the panel-level rigid-plastic model pins a whole bay as yielded the moment the mechanism forms, so below full plasticity the model cannot resolve partial yielding and its damaged volume is a mechanism-level granularity artefact. Cases outside the domain are reported with their error and marked WITHHELD, never silently dropped.
comparison_domain_rule.note: The rule and the 30 % threshold were fixed during model design, before the acceptance sweep was executed; no threshold or coefficient was changed after seeing the acceptance numbers. This file is a design record, not a time-stamped pre-registration server entry.

controlled: scantlings and yield stress of the design case
changed: impact velocity V = 2/4/6/8 m/s (sweep) and striking mass 2.2e6 / 4.5e6 kg (severe and overload cases)
confounders: strain-rate sensitivity of the yield stress (not modelled)
variables.repetition_rationale: The surface is deterministic (closed-form + bisection to 1e-12 m): repetitions would return identical numbers, so the design uses cross-route agreement (fibre integration, virtual work, Simpson quadrature, closed-form root) instead of stochastic repetition. The only numerical parameter (bisection steps) is checked for sufficiency by comparing against the closed-form root (<= 1e-6 relative).

analysis_plan.aggregation: per-case values only; no cross-case averaging
analysis_plan.uncertainty: not statistical; the reported quantity is a deterministic modelling bias, bounded by the limitation list
analysis_plan.exclusions: cases outside the comparison domain are labelled WITHHELD, not excluded from the report
analysis_plan.stopping_rule: run the single acceptance script once per commit; if any criterion fails, report FAIL and do not retune coefficients

dependencies: torch==2.14.1 (repository requirement, unused by this surface)
environment.resource_limits: pure Python + numpy-free scalar arithmetic; runtime < 60 s on one core, no cluster job required

safety: no external state, no network, no writes outside the run output directory
